name: Kino
oneLiner: 代码优先的协作视频编辑器：素材存储、实时多人时间线和审阅链接合一，剪辑与动效都以代码表示，Codex/Claude Code 等 Agent 可直接参与编辑
oneLinerEn: Code-first collaborative video editor: footage storage, a real-time multiplayer timeline and review links in one, with edits and motion graphics expressed as code so agents like Codex or Claude Code can edit too.
